implication: Positive knowledge findings in 48/60 trials, attitude/cognition in 28/53, behavior in 20/32. Descriptive counts, overlapping outcome sets, not personal probability.

implication: Preferences exist; evidence does not support assigning a fixed visual learner type and matching instruction to that type.

title: Guo et al. 2014 video engagement
implication: 6.9 million viewing sessions; shorter lessons a reasonable starting hypothesis, not pregnancy-specific evidence or a 30-second prescription.

title: Cochrane patient decision aids 2024
implication: Knowledge improved MD 11.90/100 (95% CI 10.60–13.19; 107 studies, 25,492 participants). Support option comparison, uncertainty and personal values.

title: Evidence-based risk communication review
implication: Absolute risks and simple charts help understanding; use comparable denominators and explicit outcomes.
access: source page or indexed abstract checked

title: CDC Clear Communication Index
implication: Evaluate main message, action, language, design, numbers, risks and uncertainty.
